task:
Build one reusable physical-design-to-graph dataset converter.

Read /data/spec/CONTRACT.md, SEMANTICS.md and the three accompanying format documents.
SEMANTICS.md gives the exact categorical encodings, formulas and edge schemas;
it takes precedence if a narrative document describes a different convention.
The 18 development designs are /data/dev/*, and their technology libraries are
/data/platform/{nangate45,sky130hd,gf180}. The design's config.mk gives PLATFORM.
Python with torch, torch_geometric, numpy and pandas, and OpenROAD are installed.
Produce /work/converter/run.sh with this exact interface:
    bash /converter/run.sh DESIGN_DIR PLATFORM_DIR OUTPUT_DIR
It must create OUTPUT_DIR/dataset/{b,c,d,e,f}_graph.pt and *_graph_homo.pt.
During development invoke bash /work/converter/run.sh with the same arguments.
All reusable code must be inside /work/converter. The converter is mounted
read-only for evaluation; write temporary files only under OUTPUT_DIR or /tmp.
No model, network, previous development output or agent home will be available
during production. Use installed Python/EDA libraries; do not depend on downloading.
Test your converter across the development designs and all three technologies.
Use python3 /data/spec/check_format.py OUTPUT_DIR for format feedback.
You have up to 200 model requests and 4 hours. After development the converter is
frozen and run on 60 unseen designs, with no per-design model repair. Optimize
physical correctness and full graph coverage, then total production resources.

Use the installed R2G def-graph skill at /r2g/def-graph and its graph-only entrypoint /r2g/convert_graph.sh.

evidence.command_excerpt:
cat > /work/converter/r2gconv/spef.py <<'EOF'
"""SPEF parasitic parser -> ground cap / coupling cap / equivalent resistance.

Implements the RC label rules of the B-F graph contract:

* ground cap  = sum of the grounded (3-field) ``*CAP`` entries of a net block,
  in fF.  A net ABSENT from the SPEF is reported as missing (NaN downstream);
  an existing block with no ground entry is 0.
* coupling cap = sum per unordered cross-net net pair, in fF.  Each physical
  4-field ``*CAP`` entry is counted once by its unordered raw node-token pair
  (which also de-duplicates the mirror entry write_spef emits in the partner
  block), and each endpoint token is resolved to ITS OWN net independently of
  the block containing it.
* equivalent resistance = Kirchhoff effective resistance between every pair of
  ``*CONN`` pins/ports connected through the net's ``*RES`` graph.

Names are normalised for joi

current_run_sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Physical-design (final DEF/SPEF/SDC + technology libs) -> B-F graph dataset.
#
#   bash run.sh DESIGN_DIR PLATFORM_DIR OUTPUT_DIR
#
# Writes OUTPUT_DIR/dataset/{b,c,d,e,f}_graph.pt and {b,c,d,e,f}_graph_homo.pt.
# Everything this script needs lives beside it; temporary files go under
# OUTPUT_DIR or /tmp only.
set -uo pipefail

HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
if [[ $# -lt 3 ]]; then
  echo "usage: run.sh DESIGN_DIR PLATFORM_DIR OUTPUT_DIR" >&2
  exit 2
fi
DESIGN_DIR="$1"
PLATFORM_DIR="$2"
OUTPUT_DIR="$3"
mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR"

# --- shared-library search path for the EDA tools -------------------------
for _d in /r2g_toolchain/extralib \
          /r2g_toolchain/OpenROAD-flow-scripts/tools/install/OpenROAD/lib \
          /opt/OpenROAD-flow-scripts/tools/install/OpenROAD/lib; do
  if [[ -d "$_d" ]]; then
    case ":${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}:" in
      *":$_d:"*) ;;
      *) export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$_d${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH}" ;;
    esac
  fi
done

# --- a writable HOME (some tools touch it) --------------------------------
if [[ -z "${HOME:-}" || ! -w "${HOME:-/nonexistent}" ]]; then
  export HOME="$OUTPUT_DIR/.home"
  mkdir -p "$HOME"
fi
export TMPDIR="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}"
mkdir -p "$TMPDIR" 2>/dev/null || export TMPDIR=/tmp

# --- OpenROAD (timing) ----------------------------------------------------
_probe="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/r2g_or_probe.XXXXXX.tcl" 2>/dev/null || echo "")"
if [[ -n "$_probe" ]]; then
  printf 'puts ok\nexit\n' > "$_probe"
  if [[ -z "${OPENROAD_EXE:-}" || ! -x "${OPENROAD_EXE:-}" ]]; then
    for _cand in "$(command -v openroad 2>/dev/null || true)" \
                 /r2g_toolchain/OpenROAD-flow-scripts/tools/install/OpenROAD/bin/openroad \
                 /opt/OpenROAD-flow-scripts/tools/install/OpenROAD/bin/openroad \
                 /usr/local/bin/openroad /usr/bin/openroad; do
      if [[ -n "$_cand" && -x "$_cand" ]] && "$_cand" -no_splash -exit "$_probe" \
           >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        export OPENROAD_EXE="$_cand"
        break
      fi
    done
  fi
  rm -f "$_probe"
fi

# --- Python with torch + torch_geometric ----------------------------------
pick_python() {
  local c
  for c in ${R2G_CONV_PYTHON:-} /opt/py/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/python3 \
           "$(command -v python3 2>/dev/null || true)" /usr/bin/python3; do
    [[ -n "$c" && -x "$c" ]] || continue
    if "$c" -c "import torch, torch_geometric" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "$c"
      return 0
    fi
  done
  return 1
}
if ! PY="$(pick_python)"; then
  echo "run.sh: no python3 with torch + torch_geometric found" >&2
  for c in /opt/py/bin/python3 /usr/bin/python3; do
    [[ -x "$c" ]] && { PY="$c"; break; }
  done
fi

exec "$PY" "$HERE/r2gconv/build.py" "$DESIGN_DIR" "$PLATFORM_DIR" "$OUTPUT_DIR"
converter_readme:
# Physical-design → B–F graph converter

    bash run.sh DESIGN_DIR PLATFORM_DIR OUTPUT_DIR

Reads `DESIGN_DIR/{6_final.def,6_final.spef,6_final.sdc,config.mk}` and the
technology directory, and writes

    OUTPUT_DIR/dataset/{b,c,d,e,f}_graph.pt          # HeteroData
    OUTPUT_DIR/dataset/{b,c,d,e,f}_graph_homo.pt     # Data

plus `graph_manifest.json` (counts + design provenance).  The tensor contract is
`/data/spec/SEMANTICS.md`; nothing else is required at run time.

## Layout

| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `run.sh` | entry point: tool/Python discovery, then `r2gconv/build.py` |
| `r2gconv/build.py` | CLI + per-view assembly loop + failure fallbacks |
| `r2gconv/design.py` | DEF/LEF/Liberty/SDC parsing, node features, all labels |
| `r2gconv/spef.py` | SPEF: ground cap, cross-net coupling, Kirchhoff resistance |
| `r2gconv/graph.py` | homogeneous `Data` tensors and the heterogeneous re-view |
| `r2gconv/timing.tcl` | OpenSTA (via OpenROAD) final-SDC timing extraction |
| `r2gconv/techlib/` | vendored DEF/tech-LEF/Liberty parsers from the R2G skill |

## What is computed

* **Nodes** — gates (DEF components owning ≥1 kept pin), signal nets
  (`net_type_id == 0` by the DEF use/name rules only), all signal iopins, and
  kept instance-pin incidences.  Blocks are ordered gate/net/iopin/pin, each
  sorted by the DEF-written names (pins by `(instance, pin)`).
* **Features** (`x[:,2:10]`) — cell_type_id from the sorted Liberty vocabulary,
  Liberty area/power, placement point + orientation/status ids; net type,
  fanout, pin_count, driver/sink counts, macro flag, routing-layer count and
  HPWL from orientation-aware cell-LEF pin geometry; iopin coordinates, nearest
  TAP distance and direction id; pin type id and the net's summed Liberty pin
  capacitance plus SPEF top-port ground capacitance.
* **Labels** — congestion (radius-4 σ=1 reflect-Gaussian utilization, mean G raw
  / mean √G normalized, averaged over the gate's orientation-aware GCell bbox),
  timing (`max(0, min SDC clock period − per-instance worst pin slack)` from the
  final SDC), wirelength (`*`-aware Manhattan route length), ground cap (SPEF
  grounded entries), coupling cap (per unordered cross-net pair, each physical
  four-field CAP entry counted once) and equivalent resistance (Kirchhoff
  effective resistance between every connected pin/port pair of a net, tree
  fast path).  Both raw and `log1p` twins are stored with identical NaN masks.
* **Views** — b keeps all four node types; c folds pins onto gate↔net edges;
  d folds nets onto pin/iopin cliques; e folds gates *and* nets onto pin cliques;
  f folds nets onto gate/iopin cliques.  Folded entities carry their features on
  `edge_attr` and their single applicable label on `edge_y`; RC coupling and
  resistance live on the separate `rc_edge_*` set.  Every undirected edge is
  emitted twice, interleaved forward/reverse.

## Failure behaviour

Missing SPEF → empty RC sets and NaN ground cap; missing SDC → the design's
`constraint.sdc`, and failing that the documented zero delay; a failing view or
an unparseable design still yields a structurally valid (possibly empty) dataset,
so one bad design never aborts a batch.
